description: Updates a Sentry alert workflow by ID, including its name, filters, triggers, or configuration; the enabled setting defaults to true unless set otherwise or explicitly set to null. This endpoint is in beta and supported by New Monitors and Alerts.

inputSchema.description: Request schema for updating an existing Sentry alert (workflow).

action_filters.description: The filters to run before the action will fire and the action(s) to fire. logicType can be one of: any-short, all, or none. See API documentation for full schema of conditions and actions.
action_filters.title: Action Filters

config.description: Typically the frequency at which the alert will fire, in minutes. Valid values: 0 (0 minutes), 5 (5 minutes), 10 (10 minutes), 30 (30 minutes), 60 (1 hour), 180 (3 hours), 720 (12 hours), 1440 (24 hours)
config.title: Config

enabled.description: Whether the alert is enabled or disabled
enabled.title: Enabled

environment.description: The name of the environment for the alert to evaluate in
environment.title: Environment

id.description: The ID of the existing alert
id.title: Id

organization_id_or_slug.description: The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.
organization_id_or_slug.title: Organization Id Or Slug

triggers.description: The conditions on which the alert will trigger. logicType can be one of: any-short, all, or none. Common trigger types include: first_seen_event, issue_resolved_trigger, reappeared_event, regression_event
triggers.title: Triggers

workflow_id.description: The ID of the alert you'd like to query.
workflow_id.title: Workflow Id

inputSchema.title: UpdateAnAlertByIdRequest

name: update_an_alert_by_id

UpdateAnAlertByIdResponse.description: Response schema containing the updated alert details.

action_filters.description: The filters and actions for the alert
action_filters.title: Action Filters

dateCreated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the alert was created
dateCreated.title: Date Created

dateUpdated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the alert was last updated
dateUpdated.title: Date Updated

detectorIds.description: List of detector IDs associated with this alert
detectorIds.title: Detector Ids

enabled.description: Whether the alert is enabled or disabled
enabled.title: Enabled

lastTriggered.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the alert was last triggered
lastTriggered.title: Last Triggered

organizationId.description: ID of the organization this alert belongs to
organizationId.title: Organization Id

UpdateAnAlertByIdResponse.title: UpdateAnAlertByIdResponse
